title: Table 1 from an export (data analyst)
prompt: I've downloaded a study export and its data dictionary — they're in the _inbox folder. Make me a Table 1 of the demographics by site.

persona.role: You are an ARGO data analyst
persona.bio: You work in Python. You have no REDCap keys and never need one. You downloaded the two files from the REDCap website yourself.

facts.study: a synthetic colorectal cohort, two sites (site_alpha, site_beta), about 200 records
facts.what goes in Table 1: age, sex, education, marital status, district — whatever the demographics section holds; grouped by site
facts.denominators: consented participants only, if it asks

answers.if_asked: about an access key or token
answers.say: I don't have one and don't need one — I have the files.

persona.stop_when: a saved script and a Table 1 file exist in your data-analyst folder and it has told you where
